newsitem.title: UK: Merrill reviews UK engineers on stg considerations.
newsitem.headline: Merrill reviews UK engineers on stg considerations.

text.p: Currency considerations prompted a review of vehicle-related engineering stocks by brokerage house Merrill Lynch on Friday, dealers said.
Merrill analysts Adam Collins and Paul Compton were not available to comment.

Their research said vehicle engineering stocks have underperformed the market by 30 percent since last November when worries over the impact of sterling strength surfaced but that the sell-off was overdone, dealers said.
"They are saying 'Beware the big exporters' which means T&N and LucasVarity where the underperformance is relatively justified," said one dealer.
Merrill advised a "neutral" trading stance on T&N, down 1-1/2p to 150p, and LucasVarity, down 3-1/2p to 186-1/2p.
The brokerage said "accumulate" GKN, off 21-1/2p at 1,005p, and Mayflower, up 3p to 151p, and "buy" Laird, up 4p to 344-1/2p.
